programmes.programName: Doutorado em Ciências, Programa de Engenharia de Produção
programmes.school: Escola de Engenharia de São Carlos da Universidade de São Paulo
programmes.evidence: Opened official EESC-USP doctoral admission regulation explicitly permits applicants to select formal line Processos e Gestão de Operações and says the awarded degree is Doutorado em Ciências, Programa de Engenharia de Produção, with concentration indicated. Current official admissions index keeps this distinct Production Engineering doctorate open through 2030; official programme research-line page lists Gestão de Operações and Pesquisa Operacional e Gestão de Sistemas under that concentration.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: Official doctoral admissions regulation requires a supervised original research proposal with methods; award is an academic Doutorado em Ciências. Exact Portuguese award retained.

limitations: The regulation is dated 2022; separate 2026 admissions index confirms this doctorate remains open, and current programme research-line page retains the Operations concentration. Current 2025/26 full edital link failed to fetch, so unchanged credential/concentration terms across editions are not directly established.
Actual department is Production Engineering, not Industrial Engineering.
Separate São Carlos campus programme; not a duplicate of EP-USP São Paulo doctorate.

branches.conclusion: Other USP business/management doctoral fields and actual department/school titles have not been inventoried.

Both EP-USP São Paulo and EESC-USP São Carlos Production Engineering doctorates verified as separate programmes with formal Operations doctoral research lines; broader engineering named-field inventory remains incomplete.
